src2 = r'''
import numpy as np, time
import scipy.linalg as sl
IMG=np.load("train_images.npy",mmap_mode="r"); LAB=np.load("train_labels.npy")
TR=np.arange(0,20000); VA=np.arange(45000,50000)
def layer_stats(x,rng,nmax=150000):
    P=patches(x); P=P.reshape(-1,P.shape[-1])
    idx=rng.choice(len(P),min(nmax,len(P)),replace=False); P=P[idx]
    mu=P.mean(0,dtype=np.float64)
    Q=(P-mu.astype(np.float32)).astype(np.float32)
    S=(Q.T@Q).astype(np.float64)/len(Q)
    lam,V=np.linalg.eigh(S); lam=lam[::-1]; V=V[:,::-1]
    return P,mu,lam,V
def make_filters(P,mu,lam,V,nout,kind,g,t,k,eps,rng):
    k=min(k,len(lam))
    d=np.sqrt(np.maximum(lam[:k],0)+eps*lam[0])
    Wk=(V[:,:k]/d).T  # k x dim
    if kind=="pca":
        n=nout//2
        F=Wk[:n]; F=np.concatenate([F,-F],0)
        F=np.concatenate([F,Wk[n:n+nout-len(F)]],0) if len(F)<nout else F
        w=F
    else:
        idx=rng.choice(len(P),nout*4,replace=False)
        Z=(P[idx]-mu)@Wk.T
        nz=np.linalg.norm(Z,axis=1)
        keep=np.argsort(-nz)[:nout*2]  # prefer contrastful patches
        keep=rng.permutation(keep)[:nout]
        f=Z[keep]/nz[keep,None]
        w=f@Wk
    b=-(w@mu)
    w=g*w; b=g*b-t
    return w,b
def build(cfg,seed=0,nstat=4000):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    x=prep(np.array(IMG[rng.choice(45000,nstat,replace=False)]))
    W={}
    for name,nout,c in [("c1",64,cfg[0]),("c2",128,cfg[1]),("c3",256,cfg[2])]:
        P,mu,lam,V=layer_stats(x,rng)
        w,b=make_filters(P,mu,lam,V,nout,rng=rng,**c)
        in_c=x.shape[1]
        W[name+".weight"]=w.reshape(nout,in_c,3,3).astype(np.float32); W[name+".bias"]=b.astype(np.float32)
        x=block(x,W[name+".weight"],W[name+".bias"])
        del P
    return W
def feats(W,u8):
    x=prep(u8)
    for n in ("c1","c2","c3"):
        x=block(x,W[n+".weight"],W[n+".bias"])
    return x.reshape(len(x),-1)
def accum(W,idx,bs=250,flip=False):
    D=4096; XtX=np.zeros((D,D)); XtY=np.zeros((D,10)); s=np.zeros(D); n=0; yc=np.zeros(10)
    O=np.eye(10,dtype=np.float32)
    for i in range(0,len(idx),bs):
        j=np.sort(idx[i:i+bs]); u=np.array(IMG[j]); y=O[LAB[j]]
        for fl in ([0,1] if flip else [0]):
            F=feats(W,u[...,::-1] if fl else u).astype(np.float64)
            XtX+=F.T@F; XtY+=F.T@y; s+=F.sum(0); yc+=y.sum(0); n+=len(F)
    return XtX,XtY,s,yc,n
def ridge(St,lamrel):
    XtX,XtY,s,yc,n=St
    mx=s/n; my=yc/n
    C=XtX/n-np.outer(mx,mx); Cy=XtY/n-np.outer(mx,my)
    sd=np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(C),1e-8))
    R=C/np.outer(sd,sd)
    A=R+np.eye(len(R))*lamrel
    B=sl.cho_solve(sl.cho_factor(A),Cy/sd[:,None])
    w=(B/sd[:,None]).T      # 10 x 4096
    b=my-w@mx
    return w.astype(np.float32),b.astype(np.float32)
def score(W,w,b,idx,bs=500):
    c=0
    for i in range(0,len(idx),bs):
        j=np.sort(idx[i:i+bs]); F=feats(W,np.array(IMG[j]))
        c+=(np.argmax(F@w+b,1)==LAB[j]).sum()
    return c/len(idx)
def probe(cfg,label,tr=TR,lams=(1e-3,1e-2,1e-1)):
    t0=time.process_time()
    W=build(cfg); t1=time.process_time()
    St=accum(W,tr); out=[]
    xs=[]
    # cache val feats
    Fv=[feats(W,np.array(IMG[VA[i:i+500]])) for i in range(0,len(VA),500)]; Fv=np.concatenate(Fv)
    for l in lams:
        w,b=ridge(St,l); out.append(round(float((np.argmax(Fv@w+b,1)==LAB[VA]).mean()),4))
    print(label,"val",out,"sd feats",float(Fv.std()),"cpu",round(t1-t0,1),round(time.process_time()-t1,1),flush=True)
    return W,out
'''

PCA filters beat random patches (0.597 vs 0.514 on 12,000 images), and held-out keeps rising with ridge strength, so the probe is short of data. I add one-shot supervised filters (covariance-inverse times per-region class-mean differences, i.e. LDA) to half the channels at c2 and c3 and expect a clear gain over plain PCA.

```python
src3 = r'''
TR2=np.arange(0,20000)
def layer_stats2(x,y,rng,npos=40,bs=200):
    N,C,H,W_=x.shape; d=C*9; HW=H*W_
    M=np.zeros((10,HW,d)); cnt=np.zeros(10); Ps=[]
    for i in range(0,N,bs):
        p=patches(x[i:i+bs]); yy=y[i:i+bs]
        for cl in range(10):
            m=yy==cl
            if m.any(): M[cl]+=p[m].sum(0,dtype=np.float64); cnt[cl]+=m.sum()
        n=min(npos,HW); ii=rng.integers(0,HW,(len(p),n))
        Ps.append(np.take_along_axis(p,ii[...,None],1).reshape(-1,d).copy())
    P=np.concatenate(Ps); mu=P.mean(0,dtype=np.float64)
    Q=(P-mu.astype(np.float32)); S=(Q.T@Q).astype(np.float64)/len(Q)
    lam,V=np.linalg.eigh(S); lam=lam[::-1]; V=V[:,::-1]
    return P,mu,S,lam,V,M/cnt[:,None,None]
def lda_filters(M,mu,S,lam,H,G,n,eps,cosmax):
    # region-by-class mean differences, whitened through S
    HW=M.shape[1]; pos=np.arange(HW); r=pos//H; c=pos%H
    gid=(r*G//H)*G+(c*G//H)
    Sr=S+np.eye(len(S))*eps*lam[0]
    cf=sl.cho_factor(Sr)
    cand=[];sc=[]
    for g in range(G*G):
        mg=M[:,gid==g].mean(1); md=mg.mean(0)
        for cl in range(10):
            dm=mg[cl]-md; w=sl.cho_solve(cf,dm)
            q=w@dm
            sc.append(q); cand.append(w/np.sqrt(w@S@w+1e-12))
    cand=np.array(cand); order=np.argsort(-np.array(sc))
    SC=S@cand.T   # d x m
    keep=[]
    for i in order:
        if keep and np.max(np.abs(cand[keep]@SC[:,i]))>cosmax: continue
        keep.append(i)
        if len(keep)==n: break
    return cand[keep]
def build2(cfg,seed=0,nstat=6000):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    idx=rng.choice(45000,nstat,replace=False); y=LAB[idx]
    x=prep(np.array(IMG[idx])); W={}
    for name,nout,c in [("c1",64,cfg[0]),("c2",128,cfg[1]),("c3",256,cfg[2])]:
        P,mu,S,lam,V,M=layer_stats2(x,y,rng)
        nl=c.get("nlda",0); g,t=c["g"],c["t"]
        np_=nout-nl
        w,_=make_filters(P,mu,lam,V,np_,c["kind"],1.,0.,c["k"],c.get("eps",1e-4),rng)
        if nl:
            F=lda_filters(M,mu,S,lam,x.shape[2],c.get("G",4),nl,c.get("leps",1e-3),c.get("cosmax",.8))
            if len(F)<nl:
                print("lda short",len(F))
                F=np.concatenate([F,F[:nl-len(F)]*-1])
            w=np.concatenate([w,F],0)
        b=-(w@mu)
        w=g*w;b=g*b-t
        C=x.shape[1]
        W[name+".weight"]=w.reshape(nout,C,3,3).astype(np.float32); W[name+".bias"]=b.astype(np.float32)
        x=np.concatenate([block(x[i:i+500],W[name+".weight"],W[name+".bias"]) for i in range(0,len(x),500)])
        del P
    return W
def probe2(cfg,label,tr=TR2,lams=(.1,.3,1.)):
    t0=time.time()
    W=build2(cfg); t1=time.time()
    St=accum(W,tr); out=[]
    Fv=np.concatenate([feats(W,np.array(IMG[VA[i:i+500]])) for i in range(0,len(VA),500)])
    for l in lams:
        w,b=ridge(St,l); out.append(round(float((np.argmax(Fv@w.T+b,1)==LAB[VA]).mean()),4))
    print(label,"val",out,"wall build",round(t1-t0,1),"rest",round(time.time()-t1,1),flush=True)
    open("results.txt","a").write(label+" "+str(out)+"\n")
    return W,out
'''
```
